scientific_integrity: The general result follows from a written algebraic proof. Independent audit and validation have not been performed; exhaustive small-field experiments are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The algebra is defined using a nondegenerate symmetric bilinear form over a finite field of odd order, with d>=2. Only rank-one retractions are classified into automorphism orbits. The general rank enumerator uses classical orthogonal subspace counts. No exhaustive history claim is made.
title: Witt-sensitive retraction spectra of quadratic-bracket Leibniz algebras
